samples.review: Inspected GET worker-by-ID: one required ID path input, worker response, documented 400/401/403/404 errors, no write. The historical source omits operationId and machine-readable auth despite documenting Workday permissions. Approval is only for a disposable local-mock bundle; it makes no claim about tenant authentication or worker-data access.
Read-only retrieval in the downloaded contract. Approval is confined to a disposable loopback test bundle; no vendor execution or tenant authorization is inferred.
